title: UpdateAssistantConversationRequest
description: Request body of PATCH /api/assistant-conversations/:id (HEL-663) -- pin/unpin and/or rename. Both fields are plain optional (absent = unchanged); a rename is permanent and is never re-derived once set (design.md D6). HEL-1755 adds `model`.

pinned.description: When present, sets the conversation's pinned state.

title.description: When present, permanently overrides the conversation's title (derived or default).

model.description: HEL-1755: a selectable catalog id sets the conversation's model (any other string is a 400, nothing changes); null clears it so the user's default, else the server default, applies; absent leaves it unchanged. Applies from the next turn.
